title: zingiber roseum
intro: Zingiber roseum, commonly known as Yellow Ginger, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the ginger family (Zingiberaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing nausea and inflammation, as well as exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Zingiber roseum include its ability to warm and stimulate the body, making it useful in traditional medicine for treating digestive issues and colds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include compounds such as gingerols and shogaols, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
